name: Ambient
rootCause: Scroll-based DEX protocol Ambient Finance announced on X platform that their domain has been hijacked. Until further notice, please do not interact with the Ambient Finance frontend.

descriptions.text: Scroll-based DEX protocol Ambient Finance announced on X platform that their domain has been hijacked. Until further notice, please do not interact with the Ambient Finance frontend.

Ambient Finance's domain was hijacked via a DNS attack on 17 October 2024, redirecting users to a malicious frontend that injected the Inferno Drainer malware. No confirmed user losses or affected smart contracts are reported. The team regained control quickly, and the attack targeted only the web interface. Attackers compromised Ambient Finance's domain registrar credentials, allowing control of DNS settings and redirecting users to a fraudulent frontend that injected wallet-stealing malware.
